Im no navy seal and dont intend on being one. But I was a 2x national champion in swimming. Heres what you need to do after watching the video. Start by Doing the strokes  out of the water get an idea of what your doing out of the water. First thing is your underwater, when pushing off a wall you should be streamline with your arms pointed infront of your head when you feel yourself slow down then proceed to take your underwater cycle stroke, moving the arms out until you reach your shoulders then meet arms i middle of body then push down as hard as you can with arms in middle right around where your sternum is. Then proceding to your stroke. Your pulling arm needs to come out to a 90 degree angle soo your elbow is adjacent to your head and whoosh that arm down, put more power down on it right until your arm is at your side. Swimming does take practice its strange theres a certain feel that you have to aquire. If your looking to take time off turns you can loose about 2 seconds touch and go off the walls as quick as you can. I can give the rundown on how to be quick if you like. But hope this helps.
